description: This file defines an interface for a task queue used within the GuzzleHttpomise library. It declares methods to check if the queue is empty, to add tasks, and to run all pending tasks.

classes.name: TaskQueueInterface
classes.description: Interface that specifies the methods for a task queue handling async tasks in the promise library.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the task queue has no pending tasks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue to be executed later.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all pending tasks in the queue.
